prompt.description: User prompt to send to the model.

model.description: Model name passed to the provider.

expected_substrings.description: Strings that must appear in the model's reply.

forbidden_substrings.description: Strings that must NOT appear in the model's reply.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema the model's reply must conform to.

semantic_threshold.description: Minimum Jaccard similarity vs. reference_reply (if provided).

reference_reply.description: Reference text used to compute semantic_threshold.

capture.description: Free-form metadata about the original capture.

fixture_response.description: Optional canned response for offline (fixture) provider.

context.description: Optional context (RAG) the reply is expected to be grounded in.

judge_criteria.description: Optional free-text criteria for a G-Eval-style scorer.

judge_scorers.description: Scorers to apply via the LLM-as-judge layer (offline in CI, live in dev).

message_assertions.description: Per-message assertions for multi-turn fixtures. Each entry has role (system|user|assistant|any), must_contain (list of strings), and must_not_contain (list of strings). Evaluated against every message with that role in the chat history.
